rows: Document: Occupational Safety and Health and Civil Defence

This form was prepared by the Maintenance Procedures Development and Quality Control Sector of the Holding Company, with the agreement of the MPIS coordinators of the generation companies, for the purpose of quality control of all equipment at power stations of the electricity generation companies
Maintenance record for fire fighting equipment
Fitness test and recharging record for fire fighting equipment
Employee occupational safety and health categories record
Record of minutes of mock fire drills and employee training on fire fighting
File of station security plans, personnel and equipment safety, and minutes of continuous training on them
Record of minutes of Occupational Safety and Health Committee meetings, signed by members and the committee chairman
Record of minutes of Civil Defence and Fire Committee meetings, signed by members and the committee chairman
Record of annual medical examination of 100% of employees
Decision forming the Occupational Safety and Health and Civil Defence Committee
Circulation of accident reports and penalties to prevent recurrence
Use of PPE by station employees
Soundness of hall doors and panels "operating cabinets"
General cleanliness, lighting, no seepage or water
More than one entrance and exit to the basement, with doors secured to open from inside
Coating the cable entries to the basement with a fire-retardant material
Automatic fire extinguishing network for the basement
Cable trays and safety distances between them
Sealing and securing cable entry and exit openings
Labelling and numbering of cables at the entrances and exits
